text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: routing-health.region-weight-anomaly detected for service redwood-api. Spike in 5xx and latency from ap-south1 -> eu-west2 paths. Severity: P1. Alerts from telemetry and external health checks.

sara_oncall: paging received, I'm jumping on. acknowledging. assigning initial triage to @mike_net for network checks and @ana_sre for runtime/serving.

mike_net: seeing asymmetric traffic shift in steering logs — weight for eu-west2 jumped from 0.15 -> 0.6 around 4623456400. suspect controller applied a bad weight rewrite during policy rollout. running query to confirm active pins:
```bash
# check recent routing weight writes from operator logs
gcloud logging read 'resource.labels.cluster_name="redwood-router" AND jsonPayload.event="apply-weight"' --limit 50 --filter="timestamp>\"2024-04-01T00:00:00Z\""
```

ana_sre: runtime metrics show increased queue latency on eu-west2 workers; KV cache warmup thrash possible. correlating with steering change.

sara_oncall: quick customer impact check — Emily, can support pull any customer-facing errors?

emily_support: dug into ticket queue, ~12 customer sessions reported high latency / intermittent 502s starting ~4623456450, mostly EU and APAC customers using generation endpoints. No major drop in revenue calls yet, but some degraded SLAs.

mike_net: confirmed the policy rollout job id 7892 had a bad template: missing region-exclude clause which caused weights to rebalance incorrectly. I can roll it back. Proposed immediate mitigation: revert to policy commit 7889 and pin high-volume customers to their preferred region.

sara_oncall: do revert. Also enable temporary hard pin for eu-serving customers so they don't get flapped to eu-west2. Use the emergency pin API:
```http
POST /internal/routing/pins
{ "customer_id": "<id>", "region": "eu-west-1", "ttl": 3600, "reason": "mitigation - emergency pin after weight surge" }
```

mike_net: starting rollback now (deploy rollback to commit 7889). logs:
```text
[4623456782] rolling back routing-policy to commit 7889
[4623456790] rollback applied to control plane
```

ana_sre: after rollback, KV-cache coldstarts triggered a short spike but token latency is trending down. Monitoring: 5xx rate dropped from 3.5% -> 0.8% in the last 3m.

incident-bot: Automation: rollback detected for routing-policy (id 7892) by mike_net. Tagging incident: #INC-2026-042.

sara_oncall: good. @tim_ops can you run a synthetic sweep across regions to validate steady-state and probe for residual misroutes? include curl + dig checks.

tim_ops: running probes now. sample results:
```bash
# curl probe from ap-south1 -> generate endpoint\curl -s -D - https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -o /dev/null | head -n 10
HTTP/2 200
...
# dig for traffic steer record TTLs
dig +short @ns1.redwood.example steer.api.redwood.example txt"weights: eu-west2=0.15, us-west1=0.7, ap-south1=0.15"
```
All probes returned expected regions and latencies back to baseline.

mike_net: also cleared control-plane caches and forced route-sync to edge proxies:
```bash
redwoodctl routing sync --force --targets=edge-proxies --since=4623456000
```

ana_sre: running a focused replay of failed requests against the rolled-back config to validate correctness. so far 95% of previously failing traces now succeed.

emily_support: updated status page draft: "We detected routing instability affecting some customers in EU/APAC between 04:47-05:02 UTC. Mitigation applied; most services recovered. We're continuing to monitor and will follow up with RCA." Will post after ops confirms.

sara_oncall: summary for handoff: root cause appears to be a bad policy template in rollout job 7892 that omitted an exclude clause, causing abrupt weight redistribution and unintended region pinning. Impact: ~12 customer sessions with elevated latency/502s for ~15 minutes. Mitigation: rolled back to commit 7889, applied emergency pins for high-volume customers, forced route-sync and cache clears. Post-mitigation status: 5xx rate returned to baseline, synthetic probes green.

raj_platform: taking over for next shift. noted actions: verify the operator job safety checks to prevent template omissions, add a preflight that validates region-exclude rules, and schedule rerun of rollout with canary gating. I'll own the RCA doc and follow-up.

sara_oncall: thanks — handing off. final note: please pause auto-rollouts for routing-policy until we ship additional checks.

raj_platform: acknowledged. I'll open a postmortem and link to the incident ticket INC-2026-042. tagging @ana_sre and @mike_net for RCA contribs.

incident-bot: Handoff recorded. On-call changed: sara_oncall -> raj_platform at 4623460200.

tim_ops: leaving one-off probe job running for 30m to catch any recurrences. will post results in the RCA thread.

sara_oncall: closing live mitigation thread. moving notes into postmortem folder and status updated on status.redwood.ai. Good job team :thumbsup:

emily_support: posted status update and customer notif. saved affected customer IDs to ticket queue for follow-up credits.

ana_sre: follow-ups: add a step in deployment pipeline to run a delta check that ensures per-region-exclude/retain semantics are present. Also consider rate-limited weight changes rather than abrupt rewrites.

raj_platform: will own those as action items. thanks all.
